notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE
notes.notes:
Every map has received a second version with a different spawn setup:

Boxing Ring 2 (4v4)

Kart Track 2 (4v4)

Parking Lot 2 (2v2)

Stadium 2 (3v3)

New Language

The game is now fully translated into Bahasa Indonesia.

Reworked Oldbot Team Color

The Oldbot now has a new team color to make it easier to distinguish.

Small Bug Fixes

Get ready to experience the ultimate fusion of strategy and chaos! Crazy Robot Ball is a turn-based robot football game where you assemble a team of unique robots. Outsmart opponents, master different arenas, and score your way to the top in this thrilling competition for the Golden Trophy!
